17bd510b4bc52c9e.description:
What We Do
Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.
Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.
We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are
Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.
The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.
Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.
Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need
We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Accounting Solutions Consultant to join our team and help lead the successful onboarding of new customers onto Rillet.
This role is ideal for someone with a strong accounting foundation who is excited to work directly with customers and help finance teams modernize how they operate. You may come from Big 4 audit, accounting advisory, finance transformation, or an operational accounting role at a high-growth technology company. You do not need to have formally led ERP implementations before, but you do need to be systems-minded, highly organized, customer-oriented, and eager to learn quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.
We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do
• 
Lead key parts of customer onboarding and deployment, helping ensure a smooth and timely implementation experience
• 
Partner with internal teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to execute implementation plans and solve customer problems quickly
• 
Learn and analyze client accounting and finance workflows, then translate those needs into clear requirements and practical solutions
• 
Guide customers through onboarding, training, change management, and adoption
• 
Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination
• 
Track milestones, drive follow-through, and keep internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the onboarding process
• 
Identify risks early, escalate issues quickly, and help keep customer launches on track
• 
Build trust with customers by being responsive, thoughtful, and solutions-oriented
• 
Maintain clear documentation and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders

Who We're Looking For
• 
4-7 years of experience in accounting, audit, advisory, or related customer-facing roles
• 
Strong accounting foundation, with the ability to speak credibly about close, reconciliations, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and core finance workflows
• 
Excellent communication skills and the presence to work directly with customers and senior stakeholders
• 
Systems-minded and excited to learn implementation work, even if you have not formally held an implementation title before
• 
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once
• 
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high attention to detail
• 
Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams
• 
Experience in Big 4, SaaS or at a technology company is a plus

The expected base salary range for this role varies by location:
Tier A: $100,000 – $150,000
Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here.
Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.
 
Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet
• 
Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.
• 
Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.
• 
Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.
• 
Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.
Compensation: $100K – $150K • Offers Equity
• Zone A • $100K – $150K • Offers Equity

1767ab8d661c7bf0.description: **About the Company** Dentira is one of the fastest-growing, profitable healthcare startups that is revolutionizing clinic operations across multiple countries. Our flagship product transformed dental procurement by introducing the world’s first real-time price and product comparison engine for dental supplies in the US, Canada, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. Building on this success, our latest innovation, the Lab Platform, streamlines case creation and management by seamlessly connecting clinics, intraoral scanners, and dental labs. We are also pioneering the use of advanced AI technologies to tackle complex challenges like Automatic Invoice Reconciliation, procedure cost prediction etc that can be applied across various healthcare verticals that we cater to. As we continue to expand, we are actively exploring adjacent verticals and new avenues for growth while strengthening our presence in existing ones. Our ambitious goal is to achieve over 10X growth within the next 3 years. **About the Role** Dentira's marketplace connects clinics with the dental supply vendors who sell on our platform. As Senior Product Manager for the Vendor Success team, you will empower our vendors to thrive on our platform. You will own the entire product experience for our vendors — from onboarding through day-to-day operations to their long-term growth on Dentira. You'll define the strategy and roadmap for one of our most critical user segments, partnering with Account Management, Operations, and Sales across our global markets. This is an individual-contributor role, ideal for someone who's energized by B2B/marketplace products, comfortable owning a roadmap end-to-end, and motivated by building tools that directly deliver P&L impact. Join us as we continue to redefine the healthcare operations landscape. **What You'll Do** * Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for vendor onboarding, operations, and growth, translating market and vendor needs into a prioritized plan. * Lead your product area's full lifecycle — from opportunity discovery and PRDs through launch, GTM, and post-launch iteration. * Be customer obsessed. Be the voice of the vendor internally: bring data, usability research, and direct vendor feedback into every major product decision. * Partner effectively with global cross-functional teams — Account Management, Operations, Design and Engineering — to ship vendor-facing tools that are intuitive, scalable, and reliable. * Build and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap across teams to effectively address market and vendor needs. * Define clear goals and KPIs for your product area. Drive measurement discipline to build hypothesis and measure impact rigorously for your products * Maintain clear, consistent product documentation (PRDs, prototypes, release notes) so stakeholders always know what's shipping and why. * Represent your roadmap and results in executive reviews and cross-functional forums. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree with a strong academic background. * 4+ years of product management experience, including shipping both 0-to-1 and scaled products, with a track record of taking a product from early traction to broad adoption. * Customer obsession - understand key seller pain points based on data, usability sessions and effective user research * Strong data fluency — comfortable pulling and interpreting data independently to inform and defend product decisions. * Execution Rigor: Experience owning the full product lifecycle: vision → roadmap → launch → GTM. * Experience working cross-functionally (Engineering, Design, Program Management, Finance, Marketing) in a global, decentralized organization. * High ownership and a bias for action — Bring a Go-getter mindset. You’ll do whatever you need to make your product and team successful . * Structured thinking - Ability to bring structure in a high complexity/ambiguity setup. * Influence without authority - Ability to inspire and rally a cross-functional team around a clear vision, strategy and execution * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail. * High EQ and a track record of building trust with both internal teams and external stakeholders (e.g., vendors, partners). **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building seller/vendor-facing tools in a multi-sided marketplace or B2B ecosystem * Experience in healthcare, dental, or supply-chain/procurement marketplace or regulated industries * Experience working across global teams in the US, Canada, Europe, Australia, and India. * Experience designing or shipping AI and agentic features in enterprise grade products. * Track record of shipping successful software products with a significant impact on the user experience and business. 0-1 experience is a plus. * Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving cross-functional alignment in a fast-paced environment. * Demonstrated long-term thinking around strategic and business-focused goals.
